```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_1"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <!-- Collaboration with two participants: Assembler AG (internal) and Supplier (external) -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="AssemblerPool"
                       name="Assembler AG"
                       processRef="AssemblerProcess" />
    <bpmn:participant id="SupplierPool"
                       name="Supplier" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- Main process for Assembler AG -->
  <bpmn:process id="AssemblerProcess" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Assembler" name="Assembler AG">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Monthly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveInvoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Supplier" name="Supplier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInvoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monthly" name="First day of month">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression"
                        xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">R/P1M</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendOrder" name="Send order to supplier" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessOrder" name="Process order" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvoice" name="Send invoice to Assembler AG" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveInvoice" name="Receive invoice" />

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Done" name="Process completed" />

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monthly" targetRef="Task_SendOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_SendOrder" targetRef="Task_ProcessOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ProcessOrder" targetRef="Task_SendInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_SendInvoice" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInvoice" targetRef="EndEvent_Done" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
```
